minimal_fix.connect: Reuse voice_connect for openspeech.bytedance.com inside one shared deadline covering DNS, TCP, TLS and WebSocket. voice_connect.rs:10-64 has no total deadline. Do not open a second cold connect that resets it. tts_xfyun.rs:63,294,445-446 is the existing shape, host-gated to the TTS host only.
minimal_fix.idle: One absolute hold only after real user VAD or queued non-empty PCM, until the ASR result or that same connect deadline. Do not increase signed 5000ms. Do not refresh on poll, silence, ready, or retry. business_runtime.rs:54 already no-ops an unchanged deadline.
minimal_fix.preserve: Unused zero-PCM preconnection still closes without NegativeSeq. Ordered Input hold stays the ordered-path lease.
minimal_fix.explicitly_not: Do not widen all idle timeouts. A 10s connect timeout alone still loses to the observed close at 9.143s after spawn.
